crud.read: covered: independent series GET and refreshed details

checklist_items.reason: Only source selection and draft preservation branches asserted in this case.
checklist_items.12.1: Opened from the page Add control as the only dialog. The role is dialog, the accessible name is the drawer title, the component is ant-drawer-content, and the first step is the archive URL card. The community browser count is 0
checklist_items.12.3: Default focus is the drawer panel. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle the drawer controls. The drawer is aria-modal, so one focus-trap sentinel stays inside the trap and focus does not reach the page
checklist_items.1.1: On first open the custom add drawer shows an empty image-archive URL textbox. It is not required and has no maximum length. Its placeholder is https://containerimages.example/runner.tar. Resolve is visible. Archive size, the references inside the archive, and the community repository browser are absent. Series name is an empty textbox, not required, with no maximum length, and its placeholder says to leave the name blank so the image repository groups it. Image reference is an empty required textbox with no maximum length and placeholder registry.example/team/image:v1. Engine version is an empty textbox, not required, and its placeholder gives the example 0.17.1. Framework version is an empty required textbox and its placeholder gives the example 12.8. The inference engine and framework selects are visible and have no selected value. The only selected value is multi. The rolling-tag switch is visible, unchecked, and not required. There is no spinbutton and there are five textboxes. Reading the drawer sends no import POST. The later import POST sends an empty engine version. The independent GET stores engine version 4.5.6 inferred from the image reference, framework cuda, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, rolling tag false, and that archive address as the only registry source.
checklist_items.1.8: The registry source field is one multiple select. Filling every optional field, series name archive-full, engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, the rolling tag on, and registry source https://containerimages.example/archive-full.tar, with the required image reference registry.example/team/archive-full:v9.9.9, engine vllm, framework cuda, and framework version 12.8, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body carries that series name and those version fields, source custom, rolling tag true, and that one registry source. The 200 response is one series named archive-full, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The independent GET keeps engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, rolling tag true, framework version 12.8, and that registry source. The list shows the series and opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches that GET. A separate create that leaves series name, engine version, the rolling tag, and registry sources untouched stores the backend defaults: derived name team/minimum, inferred engine version 1.2.3, architecture multi, rolling tag false, purpose inference, enabled true, and no registry sources. Both series are catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.7: The custom add control is one primary button with an icon. Filling only the required image reference, engine, framework, and framework version, and leaving series name, engine version, and the rolling tag untouched, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body names no series, sends engine vllm, framework cuda, source custom, an empty engine version, framework version 12.8, arch multi, image reference registry.example/team/minimum:v1.2.3, rolling false, and no registry sources. The 200 response is one series named team/minimum, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The list shows that series. Opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches the independent GET, including engine version 1.2.3 inferred from the reference, framework version 12.8, arch multi, rolling false, and no registry sources. The series is catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.3: The archive URL row is one compact space. Image reference, inference engine, framework, and framework version are the required fields on the custom add drawer. With the other three filled, submitting an empty image reference shows the enter-an-image-reference sentence on the image reference field and sends no image import. Submitting a whitespace-only image reference shows the tag sentence on that field and sends no image import. Submitting an empty framework version and submitting a whitespace-only framework version each show the enter-a-framework-version sentence on the framework version field and send no image import. The engine and framework comboboxes are read-only, so a whitespace string cannot be entered. Clearing the engine shows the select-an-inference-engine sentence on the engine field and sends no image import. Clearing the framework shows the select-a-framework sentence on the framework field and sends no image import.
checklist_items.1.9: While the image import POST is held the Add Image button stays loading and a second click sends no further import. The continued 200 is the only stored series
checklist_items.1.10: The real 502 IMAGE_ARCHIVE_URL_UNREACHABLE keeps the import drawer and the manual reference, shows the archive reason, and stores no series. The later resolve and import 200 match the independent detail GET
checklist_items.1.14: After the archive import, reloading the images page and opening the series shows the saved image reference. That reloaded detail agrees with the independent series GET, including the reference and the archive source. The series is catalog metadata with no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the image import is held the Add Image button shows the loading state and a second click sends no further import; the earlier real 502 keeps the manual reference, shows HTTP 502 · IMAGE_ARCHIVE_URL_UNREACHABLE, and stores no series; the continued 200 matches the independent detail GET and the reloaded link
